claude.request:
Today's international headlines:
- Israel confirms soldiers fired at car in which Hind Rajab was killed and opens criminal investigation: The five-year old Gaza girl initially survived the attack and pleaded for help but her body was recovered later with those of six of her relatives.
- Sacked Ukrainian defence minister calls for presidential election: Martial law has been in place in Ukraine since February 2022, under which elections are suspended.
- Trump pauses new tariffs on Canada for three days, saying deal close: The US president says the two sides are finalising documents to avert import taxes targeting a range of Canadian goods.
- South Korea shortens war games with US, citing Washington request: It comes after Trump announced plans to curtail joint military exercises with South Korea, citing a "very good" relationship with North Korea's Kim Jong Un.
- Ukrainian man arrested in Croatia over Nord Stream pipeline blasts: The man is alleged to have been one of the scuba divers who planted explosives on the pipelines in 2022.
- Six tourists and pilot killed in Kenya helicopter crash: The Aircraft Accident Investigation Department tells the BBC the nationalities are yet to be confirmed.
- Apparent human remains found in US reservoir as water levels hit record low: The skeletal remains in Lake Mead include what appears to be a human jaw with teeth attached, a witness says.
- Head-on collision between bus and lorry in Brazil kills more than 20: It is not yet clear what caused the two vehicles to crash into each other in the early hours of Wednesday morning.
- Retail giant Target receives $1bn boost from tariff refunds: The US chain said it received a $994 million pre-tax reimbursement, which resulted in its second quarter operating income rising to $2.6bn.
- Watch: SpaceX rocket spotted off Christmas Island coast: A SpaceX rocket that blasted off from Texas in July and crashed into the Indian Ocean hadn't been seen since - but now Christmas Island residents say they have spotted it being towed just off their coast.
- Trump administration can target Ethiopians for deportation: A judge's ruling on Tuesday removed the last remaining block on Trump officials' efforts to cancel Temporary Protected Status for Ethiopians.
- Angélique Kidjo becomes first African musician with Hollywood Walk of Fame star: Without Africans, no music is possible on this planet, says the 66-year-old musical icon from Benin.

image_provider.prompt: A five-year-old child's empty chair at a dinner table, rendered in bold geometric forms with stark shadows. The chair is rendered in clean, simple lines against a darkened interior space. Single spotlight creates a severe silhouette. Muted color palette dominated by deep blues and grays with a single accent of pale rose or cream on the chair itself. Style: contemporary figurative, reminiscent of memorial art installations. Composition emphasizes absence and void rather than presence.
